sentences.text: Educators and business leaders have more in common than it may seem.
sentences.read: Educators and business leaders have more in common than it may seem.

sentences.text: Teachers want to prepare students for a successful future.
sentences.read: Teachers want to prepare students for a successful future.

sentences.text: Technology companies have an interest in developing a workforce with the STEM (science, technology, engineering and math) skills needed to grow the company and advance the industry.
sentences.read: Technology companies have an interest in developing a workforce with the STEM, science, technology, engineering and math, skills needed to grow the company and advance the industry.

sentences.text: How can they work together to achieve these goals?
sentences.read: How can they work together to achieve these goals?

sentences.text: Focusing on STEM skills is important, but the reality is that STEM skills are enhanced and more relevant when combined with traditional, hands-on creative activities.
sentences.read: Focusing on STEM skills is important, but the reality is that STEM skills are enhanced and more relevant when combined with traditional, hands-on creative activities.

sentences.text: This combination is proving to be the best way to prepare today’s children to be the makers and builders of tomorrow.
sentences.read: This combination is proving to be the best way to prepare today's children to be the makers and builders of tomorrow.

sentences.text: That is why technology companies are partnering with educators to bring back good old-fashioned play.
sentences.read: That is why technology companies are partnering with educators to bring back good old-fashioned play.

sentences.text: In fact many experts argue that the most important 21st-century skills aren’t related to specific technologies or subject matter, but to creativity: skills like imagination, problem-finding and problem-solving, teamwork, optimism, patience and the ability to experiment and take risks.
sentences.read: In fact many experts argue that the most important twenty-first-century skills aren't related to specific technologies or subject matter, but to creativity: skills like imagination, problem-finding and problem-solving, teamwork, optimism, patience and the ability to experiment and take risks.

sentences.text: These are skills acquired when kids tinker (鼓捣小玩意).
sentences.read: These are skills acquired when kids tinker.

sentences.text: High-tech organizations such as NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory have found that their best overall problem solvers were master tinkerers in their youth.
sentences.read: High-tech organizations such as NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory have found that their best overall problem solvers were master tinkerers in their youth.

sentences.text: There are cognitive (认知的) benefits of doing things the way we did as children—building something, tearing it down, then building it up again.
sentences.read: There are cognitive benefits of doing things the way we did as children—building something, tearing it down, then building it up again.

sentences.text: Research shows that given 15 minutes of free play, four- and five-year-olds will spend a third of this time engaged in spatial, mathematical, and architectural activities.
sentences.read: Research shows that given fifteen minutes of free play, four- and five-year-olds will spend a third of this time engaged in spatial, mathematical, and architectural activities.

sentences.text: This type of play—especially with building blocks—helps children discover and develop key principles in math and geometry.
sentences.read: This type of play—especially with building blocks—helps children discover and develop key principles in math and geometry.

sentences.text: If play and building are critical to 21st-century skill development, that’s really good news for two reasons: Children are born builders, makers, and creators, so fostering (培养) 21st-century skills may be as simple as giving kids room to play, tinker and try things out, even as they grow older.
sentences.read: If play and building are critical to twenty-first-century skill development, that's really good news for two reasons: Children are born builders, makers, and creators, so fostering twenty-first-century skills may be as simple as giving kids room to play, tinker and try things out, even as they grow older.

sentences.text: Secondly, it doesn’t take 21st-century technology to foster 21st-century skills.
sentences.read: Secondly, it doesn't take twenty-first-century technology to foster twenty-first-century skills.

sentences.text: This is especially important for under-resourced schools and communities.
sentences.read: This is especially important for under-resourced schools and communities.

sentences.text: Taking whatever materials are handy and tinkering with them is a simple way to engage those important “maker” skills.
sentences.read: Taking whatever materials are handy and tinkering with them is a simple way to engage those important “maker” skills.

sentences.text: And anyone, anywhere, can do it.
sentences.read: And anyone, anywhere, can do it.
